description: Every tracked-KOL trade on one Robinhood Chain token in one payload, newest first (keyset paged with next_cursor + has_more): kol_name, wallet, action, eth_amount, token amount, price and market cap at the trade, tx_hash, log_index, block_number, dex. include_balances (PRO+) adds each KOL's CURRENT balance from balanceOf on our node (unverified with a reason when a read fails, never 0, never reconstructed from trades). Tier: BASIC (5-min delayed, 20 rows), PRO+ real time.

include_balances.description: PRO+: add each KOL's current balanceOf

name: rhc_token_kol_trades
